packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Stremio Origin 2.0 Ultra: A major update: a second player, voice search and the film's own frame rate on Google TV, faster addons everywhere.
Every film plays: On Google TV, VLC takes over by itself for any file, picture or sound the TV can't play: from the same point, your language kept.
Search by voice: On Google TV, press Search on your remote in Search, or the microphone key, and say a title in English or Arabic.
Picture in step, sound everywhere: The screen follows the film's frame rate when Match content frame rate allows it. Dolby and DTS sound from any speakers.
